source.author: verg
source.text: Haec genitor digressu dicta supremo fundebat: famuli collapsum in tecta ferebant.
source.text_original: Haec genitor digressu dicta supremo / fundebat: famuli collapsum in tecta ferebant.
source.text_english: These were the words the father was pouring forth at the final parting; the attendants were carrying him, collapsed, into the house.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ille suo collapsam pectore matrem sustinuit magnaque senem cervice recepit.
reuse.text_original: ille suo collapsam pectore matrem / sustinuit magnaque senem cervice recepit.
reuse.text_english: He supported his mother as she collapsed against his breast, and with his great neck he received the old woman.
